divergences.reason: The pinned TypeScript grammar now colors TypeScript-specific declarations and annotations instead of using the JavaScript grammar.
divergences.upstreamRationale: The pinned upstream syntax set adds TypeScript.sublime-syntax and maps ts/mts/cts/typescript to it.

divergences.reason: The pinned TypeScriptReact grammar distinguishes TS annotations, JSX tags, and JSX attributes from the old JavaScript fallback.
divergences.upstreamRationale: The pinned upstream syntax set adds TypeScriptReact.sublime-syntax and maps tsx to it.
